compass_files_read: compass/src/ai/agent.ts (pattern confirmed in earlier round; this round is about PROMPT QUALITY)
reference_notes.quality_bar_from_compass: Compass's buildSystemPrompt gives ~210 lines of behavioral guidance on top of injected live state: named disambiguation rules stated as explicit contrasts (pause_task vs cancel_task with example phrases on each side), explicit 'USE THE TOOL, don't just describe what you'd do', fuzzy-matching instructions with a ONE-clarifying-question fallback for ambiguous matches, per-domain worked scenarios (user says they finished something -> fuzzy-match open tasks -> status=done), and explicit reasoning instructions for messy real-world signals (relative time anchoring, never guess, never hedge). Codex's dispatchSystemPrompt is currently 4 short bullets + 4 path bullets with NO worked examples and NO explicit note-vs-instruction rule.
reference_notes.codex_prompt_confirmed_current_state: worker/src/gemini.js dispatchSystemPrompt(tree) lines 585-601: one-line role + injected tree + 3 classification bullets + 4 path-targeting bullets. The thin rule 'If the user gives you information without an explicit command, that is a note to save: call file_note' is exactly the unqualified phrasing that biases ambiguous/indirect messages toward file_note. file_note's own tool description ('Use whenever the user gives you content to remember... including when they just state a fact, idea, reminder or task with no explicit command') reinforces the same bias and is in scope for tightening.

fixes.name: Gather real before-evidence across a varied test set
fixes.plan: Harness runs the REAL exported classifyAndDispatch against the REAL D1 key pool (read via Cloudflare API, masked in output), the REAL live notebook tree (GitHub API), real Gemini API (model per env, default production gemini-flash-lite-latest with fallback gemini-flash-latest on saturation), with ONLY the Telegram Bot API intercepted to capture which tool fired with what args. Test set: >=6 inputs covering indirect/conversational delete, read, edit, export requests + genuine conversational notes (must-stay-file_note) + transcript-shaped messy phrasings (filler words, false starts, run-on, minimal punctuation). Any test-created topics/entries are deleted afterwards and cleanup commits noted.

fixes.name: Rewrite dispatchSystemPrompt with Compass-quality reasoning guidance
fixes.plan: Expand dispatchSystemPrompt(tree): keep role line, live tree injection, and the 4 path-targeting rules verbatim; add (1) an explicit named NOTE vs INSTRUCTION disambiguation rule with 2-3 contrasting worked examples on each side including borderline phrasings; (2) explicit statement that grammatical mood (imperative vs declarative) is a WEAK signal — weigh semantic intent, especially for transcribed speech; (3) explicit messy-phrasing guidance (filler words, false starts, run-ons, missing punctuation do NOT by themselves make something a note — reason about what the message actually asks for); (4) USE THE TOOL reinforcement. Also tighten file_note's tool description so it is reserved for genuine content-to-remember and is NOT the catch-all for ambiguous messages (ambiguity about WHICH action -> best-guess action or ask ONE short question; ambiguity only about note target is file_note's job).

fixes.name: Re-validate against the exact fix-01 test set and confirm measurable improvement
fixes.plan: After fix-02 deploys (GitHub Actions -> Cloudflare Workers Builds on push to main), re-run the EXACT SAME inputs through the same harness and record literal after-results next to before-results. Pass = every previously-misfiring instruction input now triggers its matching tool with sensible args, genuine-note inputs still call file_note (no regression), transcript-shaped inputs classified by intent not surface phrasing. Iterate on the prompt if any input still fails. Verify manual commands/buttons/PDF export untouched (this round changes only dispatchSystemPrompt content + possibly tool descriptions).
